1 # Gandalf v1 — journal/
2 
3 > Wave-7 scaffolding (the committed Gandalf v1 SHIP milestone). This directory is the per-run journal
4 > for Gandalf advisor cycles. The North Star is `NORTH-STAR.md` (LOCKED); the anti-drift sleep gate is
5 > documented in `../LESSONS.md`.
6 
7 ## What gets journaled
8 
9 One entry per Gandalf cycle (a deep-think advisor pass over an artifact/effort), named
10 `NNNN-<slug>.md`. An entry records:
11 
12 - **Effort** — what was diagnosed/situated/anticipated (the subject of the pass).
13 - **Legs run** — diagnose / situate / anticipate, and whether the SITUATE firing gate fired (a
14   researchPrime commission) and whether any independent refuter fired (the refuter-firing threshold).
15 - **Output** — the committed advisor output (schema `gandalf-advisor-1`): findings, elevations
16   (with tier + the dual-axis value×groundedness score), risk_labels, and any `degraded:true` the run
17   surfaced.
18 - **Sleep gate** — the result of the anti-drift sleep gate for the cycle: `node --test test/*.test.mjs`
19   GREEN (the canary set passed) before the cycle concluded. A RED gate is recorded with the drift it
20   caught.
21 - **Advisory artifacts (PRINCIPLE-D, never gating)** — any elevation-oracle / cross-family judge
22   verdict recorded for a human to read; explicitly NOT part of the sleep gate.
23 
24 ## Invariants this journal must not violate
25 
26 - The journal is a RECORD, never a gate input. The deterministic done-floor is the test suite alone.
27 - Nothing here lifts the single-family ceiling (PROMISING) or launders a same-family commission into
28   independent-origin credit — those honesty invariants live in the seams and their canaries.
